title: Meteoritics
description: Stones fall from the sky: iron ones from the broken cores of small planets, stony ones that never melted at all since the planets formed. Look for their craters. Unlocks the assay of meteorites.

puzzle.goal: A body of mass m strikes the ground at speed v. All of its motion becomes heat, shock and a crater. Write the energy E it brings.
puzzle.name: Kinetic energy of an impactor
puzzle.ask: Find E in terajoules for the body that made Meteor Crater: m = 3e8 kg at v = @{v} m/s.
puzzle.method: The work needed to bring a mass from rest to speed v is the integral of m·v dv, which is half of m v².
